statements: The month-end totals in src/totals.mjs come out differently from run to run, and the top-regions list sometimes changes too. Someone suspects float rounding and wants to switch to a decimal library.
Find the real causes and make the same input always give the same, correct answer. Do not add a dependency.
Keep every function's name, arguments and return shape as they are today.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Make the month-end totals deterministic and correct, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
